title: Retranscribe Button
requirements: Wire the Re-transcribe button action (currently empty closure) to EntryDetailViewModel.retranscribe() which calls the injected (via transcription-service-bootstrap) service.transcribe(at: store.url(for: entry))
Subscribe to the returned AsyncStream<TranscriptUpdate>: on .partial, update transcriptText live; on .final, call store.setTranscript with the final text and source, then update entry.source
While retranscribing, show a progress indicator and disable the Re-transcribe button (isRetranscribing = true)
On .failed: show an inline failure message via a typed error state on EntryDetailViewModel and keep the button enabled for retry
Re-transcribe is only visible when entry.source == .none
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Re-transcribe displays partial results and finalizes the entry with source == .speech or .whisper
On failure the inline message renders and the button remains enabled for retry
entry.source transitions from .none to .speech or .whisper only on final success
out_of_scope: Manual transcript edits during re-transcription (button disabled)
